main_text.p: 7. Andreas Carlostadius primus in Germania Imaginum hostis, Eas templo ab-stulit: quod quia nescio & non confulto Lu-thero fecerat, acriter propterea ab eodem fuit reprehensus. Philippus Melanchthon in locis communibus, Cap. de Decalogo, reprehendit omnem Imaginum venerationem. Ioannes Caluinus libro 1. Instit., capite 11. Infanire eos minime obscurum est, qui simulacra Dei, & Sanctorum exemplo Cherubim defendere conantur. Confessio Ministrorum Ecclesiae in Heluetia ca. 4. Reijcimus non modo gentium idola, sed & Christianorum Simulacra.
main_text.head: Hæc tenent Romana, & Græca Ecclesia.
main_text.p: 1. Monastica vita non recens excogitata, sed inde usque a Christi temporibus ad nos deducta, 2. Peculiari amictu; 3. Tonsuraque nomina scribunt, 4. Et proprijs abnegatis, 5. Voto se mancipant, 6. Pauperta-tis, 7. Et castitati operam dant, 8. Et Prælatis suis obediunt, neque postmodum in seculum impune redeunt.
main_text.head: Quid Reformati?
main_text.p: 1. Martinus Lutherus de votis Monasticis; Cupio eradicata, & extincta, & abolita esse universa Monasteria, qua utinam Dominus igne, & sulphure cælesti ad exemplum Sodoma, & Gomorrhæ demergat, adeo, ut ne memoria qui-

page.notes: Left-margin marks ("(", "¢", "-") are stains or specks, not notes. Right edge shows show-through and the neighbouring page, not transcribed. The first two lines of the Latin list and the heading lines were judged from layout; "Hæc tenent" and "Quid Reformati?" are set apart as titles and marked level 2. The final "qui-" appears in the foot of the page as a catchword. Printed spelling "Pauperta-tis" contains a soft hyphen at the line end; "Monasticis" and "Confessio" are printed as shown.
